metadata/prepare.py.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Parent-authorized preparation only. This file has NOT been executed by its author.
Builds private throwaways against the parent's already-built production library.
Does not build the repository, launch the proof, or query any process/listener.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--library", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--dependencies", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
source = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
output = args.output.resolve()
if output.parent != source:
    raise SystemExit("output must be a new immediate child of the private metadata directory")
lib = args.library.resolve(strict=True)
deps = args.dependencies.resolve(strict=True)
sdk = Path("/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk").resolve(strict=True)
os.umask(0o077)
output.mkdir(mode=0o700)  # Refuse overwriting earlier proof/binary bindings.
manifest = {"status": "preparing", "commands": [], "sha256": {}, "sdk": str(sdk),
            "library": str(lib), "dependencies": str(deps), "proof_executed": False}

def bind(path):
    path = Path(path)
    manifest["sha256"][str(path)] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def save():
    (output / "build-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")

def run(command):
    manifest["commands"].append([str(part) for part in command])
    save()
    subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=120)

try:
    for filename in ["sdk_metadata.c", "fixture.c", "runner.rs", "prepare.py", "source-review.json"]:
        bind(source / filename)
    for filename in ["sys/sysctl.h", "sys/proc.h", "sys/proc_info.h", "libproc.h"]:
        bind(sdk / "usr/include" / filename)
    bind(lib)
    run(["/usr/bin/clang", "-std=c11", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-O2", "-isysroot", sdk,
         "-c", source / "sdk_metadata.c", "-o", output / "sdk_metadata.o"])
    run(["/usr/bin/clang", "-std=c11", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror", "-O2", "-isysroot", sdk,
         source / "fixture.c", "-o", output / "fixture-template"])
    for directory in ["inside", "outside", "inside-sibling"]:
        destination = output / directory
        destination.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        fixture = destination / "fixture"
        shutil.copyfile(output / "fixture-template", fixture)
        fixture.chmod(0o700)
        # Only these newly built private copies receive ad-hoc signatures.
        run(["/usr/bin/codesign", "--force", "--sign", "-", fixture])
        bind(fixture)
    run(["rustc", "--edition=2024", "-C", "panic=unwind", source / "runner.rs",
         "--extern", "media_inference_lab=" + str(lib), "-L", "dependency=" + str(deps),
         "-C", "link-arg=" + str(output / "sdk_metadata.o"), "-l", "proc",
         "-o", output / "metadata-runner"])
    bind(output / "sdk_metadata.o")
    bind(output / "fixture-template")
    bind(output / "metadata-runner")
    manifest["status"] = "built_not_run"
except BaseException as error:
    manifest["status"] = "preparation_failed"
    manifest["error"] = type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)
    raise
finally:
    save()
print("Built only; parent must separately authorize and run:")
print(str(output / "metadata-runner") + " " + str(output) + " " + str(source / "owned-run-001"))
